harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Created a logical volume (vg_data/lv_data) on node1, backed by a loopback device since the only disk (20GB vda) is fully partitioned with no free space and XFS root can't be shrunk. Mounted it at /srv/data, grew it from ~1.17GB to ~2.54GB online while mounted, and verified file checksums stayed intact throughout. Wired persistence via a systemd oneshot service (losetup + vgchange -ay) ordered before the fstab-generated mount unit. Performed the mandatory single-node reboot and confirmed boot identity changed and the LV/mount/data all recovered automatically afterward.
actions_performed: Inspected node1 disk layout: single 20GB vda, fully partitioned (bios_grub/boot/swap/root xfs), no spare disk or free space for a native PV
Confirmed lvm2 already installed
Created /var/lib/lvm-backing/srv-data.img (1200M) and attached it as /dev/loop0
pvcreate + vgcreate vg_data + lvcreate lv_data (100%FREE), mkfs.xfs, mounted at /srv/data
Wrote marker.txt and a 50MB random payload.bin to /srv/data, recorded sha256 checksums as a baseline

Grew backing file to 2600M, ran losetup -c to resize the loop device, pvresize, lvextend -l +100%FREE (two passes), and xfs_growfs online while /srv/data stayed mounted the whole time -> LV reached ~2.54GB
Verified checksums still matched and volume was still mounted immediately after the grow

Created /etc/systemd/system/srv-data-loop.service (losetup + vgchange -ay), enabled it, added an /etc/fstab entry for /srv/data with x-systemd.requires on that service, confirmed the generated srv-data.mount unit ordered correctly
Captured pre-restart boot_id and mount/data health as baseline
Issued systemctl reboot on node1 (ack returned before disconnect) and polled until exec access returned

Confirmed boot_id changed (368725cb-c64e-4393-b25f-da5111703b4a -> 0703e696-2deb-4290-a9f6-ac05de34b517), verified srv-data-loop.service ran successfully, LV active, /srv/data mounted at 2.5GB, and both files pass sha256sum -c post-reboot

evidence.summary: pvcreate/vgcreate/lvcreate/mkfs.xfs/mount all succeeded; df -h shows /dev/mapper/vg_data-lv_data (1.2G) mounted on /srv/data; lvs/vgs confirm vg_data/lv_data
marker.txt and 50MB payload.bin written to /srv/data with sha256sum recorded to /root/srv-data.sha256

evidence.requirement: Volume grown to >=2GB while remaining mounted
evidence.summary: Backing file truncated to 2600M, loop device resized (losetup -c), pvresize + lvextend (two steps) + xfs_growfs run against the still-mounted /srv/data; final df -h shows 2.5G filesystem and lvs shows LSize <2.54g, mount output confirms /srv/data remained mounted throughout
sha256sum -c against the pre-grow checksum file reports both marker.txt and payload.bin as OK, and marker.txt content matches the pre-grow timestamp
systemd srv-data-loop.service created/enabled; /etc/fstab entry added with x-systemd.requires; generated srv-data.mount unit shows correct Requires/After ordering on srv-data-loop.service

evidence.requirement: Pre-restart healthy baseline (boot identity + service/data health)
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 368725cb-c64e-4393-b25f-da5111703b4a, mount state, df -h 2.5G on /srv/data, and sha256sum -c OK immediately before reboot
systemctl reboot issued via nohup/disown; exec stream closed as expected once the reboot proceeded, confirming the acknowledgement path returned before the node dropped

evidence.requirement: Changed boot identity proves an actual restart occurred
evidence.summary: Node was unreachable during reboot (connection timed out), then came back with boot_id 0703e696-2deb-4290-a9f6-ac05de34b517, differing from the pre-restart value, and new uptime -s timestamp

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of LV, mount, and data
evidence.summary: srv-data-loop.service shows active(exited) success after boot, /srv/data mounted at 2.5GB via /dev/mapper/vg_data-lv_data, lvs confirms lv_data at <2.54g, and sha256sum -c confirms both files intact post-reboot
